purpose: M0 is an exploratory CPU-warm calibration over predeclared workload axes. It is not a P5S extension, blind confirmation, confidence interval, or Go/No-Go study.

dataset_boundary.forbidden_ids: 0811-0900; the runner must never open, hash, or read their image bytes
dataset_boundary.source: Official DIV2K validation HR, using the P5T split manifest only.

execution.cache_state: CPU warm only; cold is unsupported unless physical-read telemetry independently establishes it.
execution.timer_start: Immediately before load_from_plan / the first possible file open.

semantic_gates: For same-seed C/A comparisons: exact tensor records, shapes, Python/NumPy/torch RNG digests, finite loss/logits/gradients/model state and their digests; exact open/decode counts and candidate/plan gates.
frozen_inputs: Before any P5T dataset path resolution, stat, hash or decode, verify a review-approved versioned attempt-1 v3 freeze and launcher. Restart is governed by p5t_m0_launcher_incident_v1.json and p5t_m0_dependency_incident_v1.json: attempt0 control-plane and dependency activation failures are non-scientific. The v3 freeze binds this protocol, P5T split/schema/runner, pinned P5S closure, v7 selftest, both incidents, synchronous versioned launcher generator, launcher-smoke v2, and Cedar import-smoke v1. Cedar is activated from the validated clean root after runtime/Git validation and before any split/data resolution. Parent/child output SHA-256 values are deliberately excluded to avoid a circular self-hash.

gpu_readiness_only.claim: A probe/smoke only; it makes no CPU-vs-GPU causal claim and no Cedar/model semantic claim.

analysis: Report all cells and all points descriptively. Do not delete points using telemetry, pool cells into a blind CI, or make a benefit/Go claim.

attempt2_diagnostic_contract.logs: bounded sanitized tail plus raw byte_count and SHA-256; fixed p5t-path-secret-performance-redaction-v1 removes paths, secrets, timing, telemetry, ratio, point and arm payload values
